#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Test MyCC end-to-end: compile expressions to assembly, assemble+link them,
# run the result, and compare the exit code against the expected value.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

if [ ! -x build/MyCC ]; then
    echo "MyCC not built — run ./build.sh first" >&2
    exit 1
fi

pass=0
fail=0

# run_test <expr> <expected-rc>
run_test() {
    local expr="$1" expected="$2"
    local asm bin
    asm=$(mktemp /tmp/mycc-XXXXXX.s)
    bin=${asm%.s}

    if ! ./build/MyCC "$expr" > "$asm" 2>/tmp/mycc-test-err.txt; then
        echo "FAIL: [$expr] compiler error: $(cat /tmp/mycc-test-err.txt)"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
        return
    fi

    if ! cc -o "$bin" "$asm" 2>>/tmp/mycc-test-err.txt; then
        echo "FAIL: [$expr] generated assembly failed to assemble:"
        cat /tmp/mycc-test-err.txt >&2
        fail=$((fail + 1))
        return
    fi

    if "$bin"; then
        actual=0
    else
        actual=$?
    fi

    if [ "$actual" -eq "$expected" ]; then
        echo "PASS: [$expr] == $expected"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    else
        echo "FAIL: [$expr] expected $expected, got $actual"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi
}

run_test "1+2*3"                7
run_test "(1+2)*3"              9
run_test "10-4-3"               3
run_test "20/4/5"               1
run_test "2*3*4"                24
run_test "42"                   42
run_test " 1 + 2 "              3
run_test "-5+10"                5
run_test "-(3*4)"               244   # exit codes wrap mod 256: -12 -> 244
run_test "7/2"                  3

echo
echo "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
